title: Key combination sending
author: wongcc2012
body_snippet:
I am using v1.77 in most environment, the key combination sending option, I have set to NO, without using full screen,
sometimes the right (SHIFT / CTRL + keys) combination sometimes can be sent, and sometimes cannot. 

I have to set to (Yes) and the issue can be resolved, 

the behaviour is inconsistent in different environment when using (NO sending key combination). please help to check.
